transcript: Speaker A: Do you speak English? Speaker B: Yes. Speaker A: Prove it. Speaker B: Um, I'm here to visit my sister in Miami. I'm staying for two weeks. I have the return ticket, I'm not working, just visiting. Speaker A: Alright, how? Speaker B: J'ai utilisé Loora. Dix minutes par jour. Pour avoir des conversations comme celle-ci. Laisse-moi te montrer comment ça marche. [I used Loora. Ten minutes a day. To have conversations like this. Let me show you how it works.] Speaker C: Hello, where are you flying? Speaker B: I fly London. Speaker C: Tu veux dire "I am flying to London"? [Do you mean "I am flying to London"?] Speaker B: Yes, sorry. I am flying to London. Speaker C: Any luggage to check in? Speaker B: Mm, luggage? Speaker C: Oui, luggage. C'est les valises, les sacs, les trucs que tu prends quand tu voyages. [Yes, luggage. It's suitcases, bags, the things you take when you travel.] Speaker B: Oh, I have one luggage. Désolée, mon anglais est vraiment pas terrible. [Oh, I have one luggage. Sorry, my English is really not great.] Speaker C: Mais t'inquiète! Tu as parlé anglais combien de fois le mois dernier? [But don't worry! How many times did you speak English last month?] Speaker B: Franchement? Pas du tout. [Honestly? Not at all.] Speaker C: Et comment tu veux parler anglais couramment si tu le parles jamais? [And how do you expect to speak English fluently if you never speak it?] Speaker B: J'ai personne avec qui pratiquer. [I have no one to practice with.] Speaker C: Alors télécharge Loora. On parle tous les jours et tu verras, ton anglais va vite s'améliorer. [So download Loora. We speak every day and you'll see, your English will quickly improve.] Speaker B: Trop bien. Je vais l'utiliser tous les jours. [Great. I'm going to use it every day.]
